say:4:1910217003:1.text: What? They've got a bunch of stupid rules down here too?!

say:5:1910217004:1.text: But you're not outsiders! You're my friends!
say:5:1910217004:1.source_cn: ——但你和图澜不是外人呀，你们是我的朋友！

say:6:1910217005:1.text: I don't want you to leave... The renewal season lasts so long. I don't wanna be separated from you guys!
say:6:1910217005:1.source_cn: 我不想让你们走……洄游季要持续好长时间，我不想和你们分开……

say:7:1910217006:1.text: I want to go exploring with you! And there are still so many things I want to ask you about the world on land!
say:7:1910217006:1.source_cn: 我想和你们一起探险，还有很多陆地上的问题想问你们。

say:10:1910217008:1.source_cn: 这个主意真不错，咱就在塔拉萨待着，谁也别想赶咱走！

say:14:1910217012:1.source_cn: 反正你们也没什么事情，咱们干脆这就出发？
